name: Falcon Feed
tagline: Every pill, pound, and vet visit your pet has ever had — in one obnoxiously organized app.
positioning: The pet operating system for people who color-code their own lives and refuse to let the dog be the one thing they wing.

hero.h1: Your vet has 11 years of records. You have a shoebox.
hero.sub: Falcon Feed pulls your pet's meds, vaccines, weight, and vet visits into one dashboard — so you stop guessing whether the heartworm pill was last month or last spring.

features.title: One profile, entire animal
features.description: Meds, allergies, microchip number, and that weird lump from March — all on one screen instead of five apps and a group text with your sister.

features.title: Reminders that actually nag
features.description: Flea treatment, boosters, and pill schedules that ping you before the deadline, not three days after your dog started scratching.

features.title: Weight trends, not vibes
features.description: Log the number, watch the curve. Find out your cat is 'chonky' from a chart instead of a stranger at the vet's office.

features.title: Vet-ready in one tap
features.description: Export a clean history PDF before the appointment so you're not scrolling your camera roll for that rash photo in the waiting room.

features.title: GPS for the escape artist
features.description: Pair a tracker and set a home zone. Get an alert the second your beagle decides the fence is a suggestion.

features.title: Share access, keep control
features.description: Give the dog walker, sitter, or ex read-only access to the feeding schedule without handing over your whole account.

testimonials.quote: I foster nine cats at a time and used to track dewormer dates on a whiteboard the cats kept knocking down. Falcon Feed remembers so I don't have to. My whiteboard is now purely decorative.
testimonials.name: Danielle Osei

testimonials.quote: My clients used to text me photos of pill bottles at 11pm. Now I just check the app. It made me look about 40% more professional overnight.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitlow

testimonials.quote: Two senior labs, four medications, one very tired brain. The reminders are the only reason both dogs still have functioning kidneys. That is not an exaggeration.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

pricing.blurb: One pet, the essentials, zero excuses for the shoebox.
For households where the animals outnumber the humans.
For breeders, fosters, and people who run a small zoo.

homepage.footerBlurb: Falcon Feed keeps your animal's entire life on record so the only thing you have to remember is where you put the leash.
